challenge.description: Troubleshoot mechanical layer shift without claiming a known physical root cause

claims: Loose belts can cause layer shifting or ghosting
Belt tension should be checked against model-specific method

intake.goal: Investigate layer shifts on an FDM printer with unknown model and no direct measurements. Compare belt tension, pulley slippage, movement obstructions and step loss; propose discrimination tests and avoid asserting a verified fix.

available_parts.name: FDM printer with intermittent layer shift
